promise: We want to study whether we can have a World Cup every two years (as reported).
description: FIFA's biennial World Cup campaign (pushed with Arsene Wenger from 2021) was formally studied and proposed, with a vote expected at the 2022 FIFA Congress. UEFA and CONMEBOL campaigned against it, the vote was postponed, and FIFA quietly abandoned the plan in 2023 — the World Cup remains quadrennial.
evidence: FIFA commissioned a feasibility study in 2021 and staged consultation sessions
Expected vote at 2022 FIFA Congress was dropped after UEFA/CONMEBOL opposition
No biennial World Cup adopted; 2026 and 2030 tournaments stay four years apart
